heading: TunnelCategoryCode
text: A code that indicates categories of tunnels that can affect the applicability of a regulation.

heading: TrafficSignal
text: A traffic control device that is used to control traffic flow at intersections or pedestrian crossings using lights.

heading: CodedRegulationWithThreshold
text: A restriction defined by a code coupled with a threshold value.

heading: CompositeEnforcementMethod
text: A method of enforcing a traffic regulation that involves a combination of enforcement methods.

heading: LegalStatusCode
text: A code that indicates the legal status of a traffic regulation.

heading: PermitRequiredCondition
text: A condition that is based on the possession of a permit.

heading: FinancialEnforcementMethod
text: A method of enforcing a traffic regulation that involves a financial penalty.

heading: MeasurableConditionCode
text: A code that indicates the type of measurable condition that is assessed, including both the type of measure and the type of entity being measured.

heading: InternationalSign
text: A traffic control device that is used to convey information to road users, such as regulatory, warning, or guide signs.

heading: TextComposite
text: An attribute that consists of text (multi-lingual string) on the default area of the main pictogram.

heading: DestinationInfo
text: An attribute that indicates destination information, such as distance to destination or direction to destination.

heading: SignAttribute
text: An attribute that is associated with the traffic control device.

heading: LegalBasis
text: A legal basis provides references to the legal documents that authorize an entity to issue the types of regulations covered by a traffic regulation order.

heading: TrafficControlDevice
text: A device that is used to control traffic, such as a road sign, traffic signal, or pavement marking.

heading: TrafficRegulationOrder
text: A legally recognized document or publication issued to enact a specific traffic regulation or regulations by a competent authority.

heading: FeeRestrictionCode
text: A code indicating the type of regulation that is associated with a fee schedule.

heading: TimeValidityCondition
text: A condition that applies to a specific location.

heading: RegulatoryScopeCode
text: A code indicating the regulatory scope of a rule maker role.

heading: RestrictionCode
text: A code indicating the specific type of restriction or requirements imposed by the regulation.

heading: RegulationCategoryCodeList
text: A list of rule categories that are defined by an authority.

heading: RegulationContextCode
text: A code indicating the context of a regulation that is associated with a code pair.

heading: CodedRegulationWithFee
text: A condition defined by a code.

heading: TextualRegulation
text: A textual regulation is a rule having the force of law that is established by a regulator through a traffic regulation order.

heading: RuleMakerRole
text: A Role that includes the responsibility for creating and maintaining rules of the road or regulations for a geographic and operational scope as defined by the parent jurisdictional entity.

heading: PermitApplicationInformation
text: Details about the application of the permit.

heading: ChannelizationTypeCode
text: A code that indicates the type of channelization device.

heading: TrafficSignalDevice
text: A device that is used to control traffic signals, including traffic lights and warning beacons.

heading: StandAloneRestrictionCode
text: A code indicating the type of regulation that does not require any supplemental information.

heading: StandingOrParkingCategoryCode
text: A code that indicates categories of standing or parking that can affect the applicability of a regulation.

heading: PermitGranteeTypeCode
text: A code that indicates the type of grantee of the permit.

heading: WarningBeacon
text: A device that is used to warn road users of potential hazards or to draw attention to specific conditions using lights or signals.

heading: Trustworthiness
text: The trustworthiness of the supplemental data source.

heading: PermitGrantorTypeCode
text: A code that indicates the type of grantor of the permit.

heading: TowingEnforcementMethod
text: A method of enforcing a traffic regulation that involves towing a vehicle.

heading: AccessCategoryCode
text: A code that indicates categories of access to a location that can affect the applicability of a regulation.

heading: RegulationThing
text: A class to organize all classes defined in the Traffic Regulation topic area of the ITS Ontology.

heading: PermitDisplayTypeCode
text: A code that indicates the type of display that is associated with the permit.

heading: Permit
text: Certificate that indicates designations that are associated with the grantee.

heading: RegulationCategoryCode
text: A code used to identify a category of regulation.

heading: ImmobilizationEnforcementMethod
text: A method of enforcing a traffic regulation that involves immobilizing a vehicle.

heading: EnumeratedCondition
text: A condition that is based on an enumerated value in a known code list.

heading: ReasonCode
text: A code indicating the reason for the traffic regulation order.

heading: TroStatusCode
text: A code indicating the lifecycle status of a traffic regulation order

heading: RoadSurfaceFeatureTypeCode
text: A code that indicates the type of road surface feature.

heading: AccessControlDevice
text: A device that is used to control access to a specific area, such as a gate or barrier.

heading: SupplementalDataTypeCode
text: A code indicating the type of supplemental data required to interpret the current applicability of a regulation.

heading: CodedPairRegulation
text: A restriction defined by a code.

heading: TrustworthinessCode
text: A code indicating the trustworthiness of the supplemental data source.

heading: RoadSurfaceFeature
text: A traffic control device that changes the nature of the road surface, such as rumble strips or speed bumps.

heading: RegistrationMachine
text: A machine that is used to register the permit.

heading: RequiredSupplementalData
text: Data that a METR user system needs from a supplemental data provider to determine the current applicability of a regulation.

heading: ConditionCode
text: A code that indicates the enumerated types of conditions that affect the applicability of a regulation.

heading: ChannelizationDevice
text: A device that is used to guide or direct traffic, such as a curb or a series of cones, barrels, or barricades.

heading: SuspectStatusCode
text: A code indicating if any information about the traffic regulation has been flagged as suspect.

heading: AccessControlTypeCode
text: A code that indicates the type of access control device.

heading: EnforcementMethod
text: The enforcement method used to enforce a traffic regulation.

heading: SignDestination
text: A destination that is indicated on the road sign.

heading: PermitType
text: A category of certificate that the grantor is able to issue to designate a grantee as a specific type of entity.

heading: LogicalOperatorCode
text: A code that indicates how the members of a ConditionSet are combined (for example AND, OR, XOR, NOT, etc.).

heading: ActivationStatusCode
text: A code indicating the activation status of an object

heading: ThresholdRestrictionCode
text: A code indicating the type of regulation that requires a threshold value.

heading: VersionedCondition
text: A specific version of a condition that can be referenced by a ConditionReference.

heading: PermitDesignationCode
text: A code that indicates the designation of the permit.

heading: PavementMarking
text: A device that is used to mark the pavement, such as lines, symbols, or text.

heading: ConditionSet
text: A composite condition that consists of two or more Conditions combined by a logical operator; the set must evaluate to true for the associated regulation(s) to currently apply.

heading: RoadTypeCode
text: A code that indicates categories of roads that can affect the applicability of a regulation.

heading: TrafficRegulation
text: A traffic regulation is a rule having the force of law that is established by a regulator through a traffic regulation order.

heading: MeasurableCondition
text: A condition that is based on a comparison between a measurable value and a threshold value.

heading: LocationCondition
text: A condition that applies to a specific location.

heading: DriverCategoryCode
text: A code that indicates categories of drivers that can affect the applicability of a regulation.

heading: PavementMarkingTypeCode
text: A code that indicates the type of pavement marking device.

heading: DrivingRecordEnforcementMethod
text: A method of enforcing a traffic regulation that involves assigning demerits to a driver's driving record.

heading: CodedRegulation
text: A restriction defined by a code.

heading: Condition
text: A boolean condition that must evaluate to true for the associated regulation(s) to currently apply. Even if the condition is true, it is not active if it is currently overridden. The condition may be multi-part.

heading: RegulationObjectProperty
text: An object property to organize all object properties defined in the Traffic Regulation topic area of the ITS Ontology.

heading: accessControlType
text: A code that indicates the type of access control device.

heading: applicableLocation
text: The location associated with the condition.

heading: arrowDirection
text: A direction that is indicated on the road sign.

heading: associatedTrafficControlDevice
text: A traffic control device associated with the instance of the traffic regulation.

heading: authorizingTrafficRegulation
text: A traffic regulation that authorizes the instance of the traffic control device.

heading: channelizationType
text: A code that indicates the type of channelization device.

heading: comparisonOperator
text: The operator used to compare the value to the threshold value.

heading: destinationHorizon
text: The distance to the destination or the time to the destination.

heading: destinationPlace
text: The place to which the road sign is pointing.

heading: destinationRoad
text: The road to which the road sign is pointing.

heading: divergeHorizon
text: The distance between the sign and the junction or diverge point that leads to the point of interest.

heading: divergeName
text: The name of the point of interest (e.g., destination or current location for direction 0).

heading: divergeRoute
text: The route to which the road sign is pointing.

heading: forAccessCategory
text: The type of restriction that regulates access to a facility.

heading: forEnumeratedCondition
text: The enumerated condition that affects the applicability of the regulation.

heading: forMeasurableCondition
text: The measurable condition that affects the applicability of the regulation.

heading: forNonVehicularRoadUserType
text: The type of non-vehicular road user that is subject to the regulation.

heading: forRoadType
text: The type of road upon which travel is taking place.

heading: forStandingOrParkingCategory
text: The category of standing or parking within which travel is taking place.

heading: forTunnelCategory
text: The category of tunnel within which travel is taking place.

heading: grantsDesignation
text: The permissions that are granted by the permit.

heading: hasActivationStatus
text: A code indicating the activation status of the traffic regulation.

heading: hasApplicableLocation
text: The location where the permit is applicable.

heading: hasApplicationInformation
text: Details about the application of the permit.

heading: hasAssociatedFee
text: A fee that is associated with the instance of the traffic regulation.

heading: hasAssociatedRestriction
text: A restriction associated with the traffic regulation.

heading: hasCondition
text: A condition associated with the instance (for example a traffic regulation); not used for the part-whole composition of a ConditionSet, which uses cdm1:hasComponent.

heading: hasContactInformation
text: Contact information for the entity that is responsible for the traffic regulation.

heading: hasDefaultDurationLimit
text: The default duration of the permit.

heading: hasDefaultLocation
text: The default location of the permit.

heading: hasDefaultRepeatInterval
text: The default repeat interval of the permit.

heading: hasDisplayType
text: The type of display that is associated with the permit.

heading: hasDurationLimit
text: The maximum duration of the permit.

heading: hasGrantee
text: The entity that is granted the permit.

heading: hasGranteeType
text: The type of entity that is granted the permit.

heading: hasGrantor
text: The authority that is responsible for issuing the permit.

heading: hasLegalBasis
text: formal authority within the law (e.g., statute, ordinance, administrative rule, constitutional provision) that empowers an entity to create, adopt, or enforce a regulation

heading: hasPermitType
text: A type of permit associated with the traffic regulation.

heading: hasRegistrationMachine
text: A registration machine that is associated with the instance of the traffic regulation.

heading: hasRepeatInterval
text: The minimum time to the next entry.

heading: hasValidityPeriod
text: The validity period of the permit.

heading: implementedLocation
text: The location where the regulation was implemented (e.g., with traffic control devices).

heading: implementedValidity
text: The validity period for the condition as implemented.

heading: issuedTro
text: A traffic regulation order issued by the entity.

heading: locationByOrder
text: The location where the regulation is defined to apply per the traffic regulation order.

heading: logicalOperator
text: The logical operator used to combine the Conditions in a ConditionSet.

heading: memberTrafficRegulation
text: A traffic regulation enacted by the traffic regulation order.

heading: pavementMarkingType
text: A code that indicates the type of pavement marking device.

heading: permitInformation
text: Information about any permits that are associated with the regulation.

heading: permittedEntityType
text: The type of entity that is permitted to use the permit.

heading: reasonCode
text: A reason justifying the existence of the instance of the traffic regulation order

heading: regulatoryScope
text: Indication of the types of regulations that can be enacted by the rule maker.

heading: requiredDesignation
text: The designation of the permit that is required for the instance of the traffic regulation.

heading: requiredDisplayType
text: The display type of the permit that is required for the instance of the traffic regulation.

heading: requiredGrantor
text: The grantor of the permit that is required for the instance of the traffic regulation.

heading: requiredGrantorType
text: The type of grantor of the permit that is required for the instance of the traffic regulation.

heading: roadSurfaceFeatureType
text: A code that indicates the type of road surface feature.

heading: hasComponentSign
text: An ordered supplemental sign of the international sign; the first is the main sign and subsequent values are supplemental signs.

heading: trafficImpactLocation
text: The location where traffic is impacted due to the existence of the regulation.

heading: troStatus
text: The current lifecycle status of the instance of the containing class

heading: validityByOrder
text: The validity period for the condition.

heading: valueToCompare
text: The threshold value to compare against the current value to determine the applicability of the regulation.

heading: forRoadWeatherConditionType
text: The type of weather condition that is subject to the regulation.

heading: hasTrustworthiness
text: The trustworthiness of the object.

heading: hasOverallTrustworthiness
text: A code indicating the overall trustworthiness of the object.

heading: hasContext
text: A context associated with the traffic regulation.

heading: hasFeeSchedule
text: A fee schedule associated with the traffic regulation.

heading: hasThreshold
text: A threshold associated with the traffic regulation.

heading: hasRegulationCategory
text: A category of regulation associated with the traffic regulation.

heading: hasRestriction
text: A restriction associated with the traffic regulation.

heading: hasDetails
text: The details of the composite sign.

heading: RegulationDataProperty
text: A data property to organize all data properties defined in the Traffic Regulation topic area of the ITS Ontology.

heading: hasApplicationInstructions
text: The method by which the permit can be obtained.

heading: hasApplicationUrl
text: The URL for the application of the permit.

heading: hasInformationUrl
text: The URL for the information about the permit.

heading: image
text: An image that is associated with the traffic control device.

heading: isActive
text: Indicates whether the condition is currently active.

heading: isApplicationRequired
text: Indicates whether an application is required for the permit.

heading: isLocationSpecific
text: Indicates whether the permit is location specific.

heading: issued
text: The date and time the permit was issued.

heading: nationalSignId
text: The national sign identifier for the traffic control device.

heading: negate
text: Indicates whether the condition is negated.

heading: otherCondition
text: A separate condition that determines the applicability of the regulation.

heading: pictogram
text: The pictogram that is associated with the traffic control device.

heading: requiredPermitIdentifier
text: The identifier of the permit that is required for the instance of the traffic regulation.

heading: url
text: The URL that is associated with the traffic control device.

heading: version
text: The version of the object.

heading: compositeText
text: The text that is displayed with the traffic control device.

heading: hasInceptionDate
text: The date on which the traffic regulation can first became applicable whenever all defined conditions are met.

heading: hasTerminationDate
text: The date after which the traffic regulation became or is expected to become no longer applicable regardless of the current validity of the defined conditions.

heading: hasTextualRestriction
text: A textual restriction associated with the traffic regulation.

heading: isSuspect
text: A code indicating if the traffic regulation is suspect.
